vote.pick_target: 🎯 Pick the target on the map
vote.rule_demo: Democratic faction: a proposal passes if it has more “For” than “Against” votes when the vote closes.
vote.rule_auth: Authoritarian faction: votes are advisory (the Founder decides), except type change, dissolution and deposition, which are applied.
vote.hint_resources: E.g. use 2,000 iron to build the north wall.
vote.hint_raid: Set the date, time and target: players will see it on the map (red ⚔).
vote.hint_governance: If passed: the faction switches between authoritarian and democratic.
vote.hint_dissolution: If passed: the faction is dissolved and all members leave it.
vote.hint_depose: Only possible if the leader has been inactive for a long time. If passed: the chosen member becomes Founder.
vote.confirm_dissolution: Submit the dissolution of the faction to a vote?
vote.confirm_depose: Submit the leader's deposition to a vote?
